method: Each event is one replay piece/track ID. Midpoint STOP cloud rendered for manual scene review.
limitations: Scene appearance is separate from the cause of an alarm.
Ambiguous scenes remain uncertain; no scene labels come from detector reason codes.
Per-scene event-frame totals can overlap when several events share a frame.
Near-sensor scene appearance does not establish the scene or cause at an alarm 20.7–158.3 m ahead.
No exposure distance or duration is annotated by scene, so no per-scene false-event rate is estimated.
No switch or junction was confidently identified in these views; uncertain scenes are retained.
scene_reference: Manual near-sensor scene appearance, chiefly the 3–20 m cross-section plus top-down and angular views.
review_status: All 45 events visually reviewed; 9 near-sensor scene labels remain uncertain. Alarm causes and distant alarm-location scene labels remain unassigned.
